schema_ref: No declared schema. .claude/workflows/system_orchestration/artifact_schema_specification.yaml carries tier3_source_schemas for selected_call, topic_mapping, compliance_profile, partners, milestones_seed and working_assumptions. It carries none for the project brief, so this shape is authored, as roles.json says of its own. Phase 2 reads the brief as prose and structure, not against a schema.
artifact_purpose: The structured spine of the instance-two concept: what the project claims, which Tier 2B span each claim answers, and which partner capability carries it. Written by the ticket 'Project concept for operator approval' in plans/dev_graph_demo_tickets.md. The prose sits in concept_note.md and strategic_positioning.md; this file is the part a test can check.

topic.topic_title: Integrating Remote Sensing and in-situ observations of Biodiversity, towards a fully interoperable observation and data framework

concept.working_title: Genome-to-space biodiversity observation along the agricultural pressure gradient, from farmland to coast
concept.acronym_note: No acronym is coined. Instance two is a demonstration and is never submitted, so nothing needs one, and an invented acronym is a project identifier that could collide with a real grant. The operator may set one; it is listed in open_decisions. Operator decision OD3, 2026-09-30: no acronym is set.
concept.one_line: One harmonised observation chain, from molecules to satellites, follows a single agricultural pressure gradient through farmland, freshwater ecotones and coastal waters.
concept.anchor: Agricultural landscapes, grasslands and the ecotones adjoining them.
concept.why_this_anchor: The topic names agriculture as a pressure on ecosystems and as a sector biodiversity data must reach. The derived six carry a deep agricultural measurement base. One pressure gradient runs from farmland through the water bodies receiving its runoff to the coast, so the three ecosystem realms the scope asks for are demonstrated on one causal chain rather than on three unconnected sites.

concept_claims_note: Every claim carries the verbatim call phrase it answers and the span that phrase sits in, so a reader can check the concept against Tier 2B without trusting this file (CLAUDE.md 10.5). Every capability reference is an exact capability string from partners.json, so a claim cannot rest on a capability the consortium does not record (13.3). requirement_refs use the vocabulary of the consortium gap analysis, so the two reports can be read against each other. Status is Assumed throughout: the concept is the operator's design intent, and no partner's participation is confirmed.

project_duration.tier2b_basis: None. Pages 73 to 76 of the work programme carry no duration condition and the portal record carries none. selected_call.json carried project_duration as Unresolved for the same reason until the operator decided; it now carries the decided value as Assumed, never Confirmed, because no source can evidence it.
project_duration.reasoning_for_48: The terrestrial case needs the field archive reworked and at least two further growing seasons measured under the harmonised protocol. The freshwater and marine cases cannot start before that protocol exists, and each needs a full annual cycle. European scaling and validation then need a year on top. Thirty-six months compresses the cross-realm cycle to one season and puts the third expected outcome at risk. Sixty months buys a third validation cycle at the cost of a larger consortium burn against the same EUR 5,000,000.
project_duration.consequence_if_left_unresolved: runner/dependency_normalizer.py reads project_duration_months. Phase 3 or Phase 4 fails closed while it is absent, which is the correct output rather than a defect.
project_duration.decision_basis: Operator decision OD2, recorded in docs/tier4_orchestration_state/decision_log/demo-concept_2026-09-30.json. Assumed, never Confirmed: Tier 2B carries no duration for this topic, so no source can evidence the value (CLAUDE.md 12.2). Declared under key project_duration in working_assumptions.json and written to selected_call.json as project_duration_months, which is where runner/dependency_normalizer.py and the timeline predicates read it.

gap_options.name: Add the gap-filling partners
gap_options.summary: Run with all twelve partners. P07 to P12 close freshwater, marine, omics, data infrastructure, socio-ecological analysis and European-scale AI, and take the consortium from two country slots to six.
consequences: Every requirement class in the consortium gap analysis has a covering partner, and all three ecosystem realms are demonstrated.
The Tier 1 composition condition is met, but only under assumption: every partner that adds a third country is fictional.
Six of twelve partners are declared in working_assumptions.json as unconfirmed, so half the consortium carries Assumed into Phase 6 and Phase 7.
The concept matches the consortium already authored, so no Tier 3 artifact needs rework.

gap_options.name: Narrow to terrestrial ecosystems
gap_options.summary: Run with the derived six and drop the freshwater and marine cases.
consequences: The second scope requirement is not answered. It asks for capabilities across terrestrial, freshwater and marine ecosystems, and no reading of that span makes the three realms optional.
The Tier 1 composition condition fails outright. The derived six span two country slots and the condition needs three.
Phase 2 has to record an unresolved scope conflict, and its gate condition requires that none remain.
It is faster and needs no fictional partner, so nothing in Tier 3 rests on an invented entity.

gap_options.name: Mixed: cover the realms and omics only
gap_options.summary: Add P07, P08 and P09, and declare the data infrastructure, socio-ecological analysis and European-scale AI out of scope.
consequences: The three realms and the omics layer are covered, and the composition condition is met on five country slots.
Four cross-cutting requirements lose their covering partner: the in-situ framework cooperation, the typology crosswalks, the open science cloud link and the policy-reporting alignment.
The first expected outcome loses its trend-prediction capability and the third loses the AI mapping it names.
Three fewer partners carry Assumed, so the uncertainty ledger is smaller.

gap_option_decision.basis: Operator decision OD1, recorded in docs/tier4_orchestration_state/decision_log/demo-concept_2026-09-30.json. Confirmed as an operator act evidenced by a named Tier 4 record, not as a fact about any partner: every partner still carries Assumed.
gap_option_decision.consequence: The concept runs on all twelve partners, so no Tier 3 artifact needs rework. The composition condition stays met only under assumption, and the six fictional partners stay declared in working_assumptions.json.
gap_option_decision.note: The draft put three options with their consequences and did not choose. This block records what the operator chose.
gap_option_decision.vocabulary_note: state is a lifecycle value, not one of the four CLAUDE.md §12.2 categories. An operator's choice is an act, not a fact a tier evidences, and §12.2 reserves Confirmed for a fact directly evidenced by a named source in Tier 1 to Tier 3 — this record lives in Tier 4. The consortium gap analysis set the same precedent by giving a finding a disposition and leaving status to the four categories. What the choice implies about the project stays in field_status, where every entry is Assumed.

coordination_commitments.commitment: Earmark effort and budget for cooperation with the named in-situ data collection frameworks, and publish project occurrence records to them.
Hold an open place in the interoperability work package for the Joint Research Centre, as a zero-funding beneficiary or an associated partner, and count it towards nothing.
Ingest the Commission-steered grassland and agricultural-landscape monitoring data as a reference layer.
Provide a standing coordination interface to the space-agency earth observation projects in the same cluster.
Link the published workflows and data to the open science cloud and the common data spaces.
Use the European earth observation and satellite navigation programmes wherever the project uses satellite data, which is an eligibility condition rather than a preference.

risks_the_draft_carries.risk: The freshwater and marine realms each rest on a single fictional partner. Losing either leaves the second scope requirement unanswered, even though the composition condition survives.
risks_the_draft_carries.carried_from: Finding F4 of the consortium gap analysis.

risks_the_draft_carries.risk: Ten of the twelve partners sit in three country slots and five of them in C1. The second scope requirement asks for use cases in Member States and Associated Countries, and a reader could call the geography thin.
risks_the_draft_carries.carried_from: Finding F5 of the consortium gap analysis.

risks_the_draft_carries.risk: Every capability the concept rests on is Assumed. No partner participation is confirmed, and the derived capabilities trace to a document held outside the repository.
The topic is lump sum, so Phase 8 stays hard-blocked until an external planner response is received and validated. The concept cannot be drafted into Part B on this branch until then.

field_status_note: Two entries are Confirmed and both are checkable by any reader of this branch: the bound topic, and the call phrases, each a verbatim slice of the Tier 2B call extract (tests/test_demo_concept.py). Everything the project claims about itself is Assumed — the concept is design intent, and the capabilities behind it belong to partners whose participation nobody has confirmed. The duration is Assumed because Tier 2B carries none, so no source can evidence it. The operator's approval and gap-option choice are absent from this block on purpose: they are acts recorded in Tier 4, not facts a tier evidences, and §12.2 reserves Confirmed for Tier 1 to Tier 3 evidence. They carry a lifecycle state of their own instead. Nothing here is Confirmed on the strength of the concept's own coherence.
